timer.counter: 16-bit wrapping up-counter clocked once per E-cycle; reset 0000; a high-address write presets FFF8
timer.coherent_read: reading high latches low; low reads return that latch
timer.output_compare: match sets OCF and transfers OLVL to P21; high-byte write inhibits comparison for one E-cycle
timer.input_capture: selected P20 edge transfers the synchronized counter and sets ICF on the second negative E half-cycle; high-byte read inhibits one transfer

flag_clear.ICF: read TCSR while set, then read ICR_MSB
flag_clear.OCF: read TCSR while set, then write either OCR byte
flag_clear.TOF: read TCSR while set, then read FRC_MSB

timer.interrupt: enabled ICF, OCF, and TOF set the IRQ2 request flip-flop; I or reset clears the request while the unlatched enabled flags select distinct priority vectors late in entry

gpio.port3_port4: register addresses are external in expanded multiplexed modes 0-3

clock_modes.10: internal NRZ with bit clock on P22

sci.frame: one start, eight data bits least-significant first, one stop, no hardware parity
sci.transmitter: TE rising sends nine marks; TDR transfers at a bit boundary and sets TDRE; status-read-before-TDR-write is required to clear TDRE
sci.receiver: valid stop transfers data and sets RDRF; missing stop sets ORFE without RDRF; full RDR causes overrun and inhibits transfer
sci.flag_clear: TRCSR read followed by RDR read clears the RDRF/ORFE bits observed
sci.wake_up: WU inhibits receive flags until ten consecutive marks
sci.interrupt: RIE enables RDRF/ORFE and TIE enables TDRE into the retained IRQ2 request; all share the default FFF0:FFF1 priority-encoder vector

implementation_scope.current_profile: Normalized mode-2/mode-3 expanded-bus integration. Other modes, physical bus multiplexing, Port 3 handshake, bi-phase SCI, and external-clock SCI remain separate profiles.
implementation_scope.differential_evidence: Two deterministic seeds compare 768 independent-model E-cycle transactions per mode against internal decode, GPIO, timer, SCI, and interrupt RTL state.
implementation_scope.undefined_output_latches: RTL selects deterministic zero after reset without claiming that manufacturer-undefined silicon latch value.
implementation_scope.standby_retention: RTL exposes standby validity without claiming analog threshold or power-domain retention equivalence.
